build_manifold_pipeline: build a manifold Pipeline class with multiple sub-pipelines for Open WebUI
create_pipeline_subpipelines: create a list of sub-pipelines with unique ids and names in a manifold Pipeline
run_pipeline_on_startup: run the Pipeline on_startup lifecycle hook when the server starts
run_pipeline_on_shutdown: run the Pipeline on_shutdown lifecycle hook when the server stops
run_pipeline_pipe: run the Pipeline pipe method to handle user messages with model_id and body parameters
